pump_93.why: 8.5:1 forged 5S-GTE on 93. MatchBot IAT at 25–30 psi is still in the 47 C region after a 4.5 in core — survivable, but 93 will want timing pulled as boost climbs. Street seed stays 18 psi; 22 psi is the planning ceiling until a knock-logged pull says otherwise.

e85.why: E85 at λ≈0.78 is not knock-limited at these cylinder pressures on 8.5:1. The ceiling is compressor choke / turbine dP / IAT, not octane. 30 psi is the hardware max, not a required point.
e85.water_meth_effect: Engage ≥27 psi to cut compressor-out temp 20–40 C in the hottest island. That is extra IAT margin and can hold 28–30 psi farther into the redline band instead of tapering to 27. It is not free power — it is permission to keep the boost you already computed.

headline.note: MatchBot pump-gas hp uses official gasoline BSFC/AFR (tooltip: keep those even for alcohol). E85 crank uses 11 hp per lb/min on the same corrected airflow. Wheel figures use 17% AWD loss (carbon 1-pc shaft + lightened flywheel + rebuilt E150F).

turbo_fit.EFR_7064: 55 lb/min @ PR 3.0 is the published 56 lb/min wall. Choke. Not the turbo.
turbo_fit.EFR_7163: 55 lb/min sits on the right side of a 60 lb/min map. Usable, little choke margin at 8000/27.
turbo_fit.EFR_7670: 55 lb/min is inside a 64 lb/min map. Best top-end island; more shaft inertia than 7163.
turbo_fit.recommendation: Keep 7163-G if the car is a road car and you value 3–4k response (mixed-flow 63 mm turbine, 0.80 A/R). Step to 7670-C if the goal is holding 30 psi to 7500+ without riding the 7163 choke line. 7064 is the wrong compressor for this displacement × boost. That agrees with the prior Drive PDF on 7670-C first / 7163-G second, now on 2189 cc and 8000 rpm instead of 2164 cc / 7500.
